title: Uka Reclamación de Autoridad Absoluta ukaxa
intro: Nayra tiemponjja, mä chʼamani jaqew mä jachʼa oraqeru ukat ukan jakirinakar apnaqañatak sartasïna. Uka jaqen apnaqäwipajj wali jachʼa jachʼa tukuñampiw uñjasïna ukat Diosan autoridadaparuw wal chʼamachasïna. Mä almax khitïpachas uk uñt’ayañatakiw wakicht’asipxam, ukat qhipa destinopax taqi generacionanakatakix mä wiñay yatichäwiruw tukuwayi.
clues: Nayajj mä jachʼa imperioruw apnaqawayta, ukanjja arunakajajj leyinkänwa.
Nayajj jachʼa diosätwa sasaw yatiyayäta, apnaqäwijan taqe jaqenakaruw yupaychapjjañapatak mayiyäta.
Mä comunidadaruw tʼaqhesiyayäta, esclavoruw tukuyta ukat jiskʼa chachanakapar jiwayapjjañapatakiw mayïna.
Walja kutiw Diosan mä altʼat chuyman khitatapampi uñkatasiyäta, jupajj naya nayraqatansa ukat layqanakaja nayraqatansa qhana milagronak luräna.
Nayajj qala chuymampiw cheqa yatichäwinak apanukuyäta, khitarus layqasiñat juchañchayäta ukat juparus arkirinakaparus tʼunjañatakiw amtayäta.
Taqi ejercitojampi nayampixa lamar qutampiw chʼamaktʼayasipxta, kunattix jan jaytjasaw khitinakatï amparajat qhispiyatäpkäna ukanakar arknaqapkayäta.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
